# Vercel — Style Reference

> Graphite ink on gallery plaster, a single black prism at center. Geist at weight 450 is pulled to -0.06em on a #fafafa canvas, every edge is drawn as a one-pixel ring, and blue appears exactly twice.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

This is an ink-on-plaster infrastructure language in which hierarchy comes from size and negative tracking alone. The canvas is #fafafa. Paper-white #ffffff cards and buttons sit one step above it, and #171717 serves as both headline ink and the only filled surface. The chromatic budget is effectively zero: one saturated hue, #0070f3, has exactly one background use and one text use on the entire page, and every CTA, logo and illustration is monochrome. Geist runs at 400 to 500 for 99% of its 146 measured elements. Display headlines sit at 56–64px, weight 400–450 and -0.06em tracking, which is softer than the conventional 700 headline. The scale is not modular. It jumps from 24px to 56px, a 2.33× cliff where a Perfect Fourth would climb in four gentle steps. Shapes split between 9999px pills for marketing CTAs and 6px rectangles for header controls. Elevation is a box-shadow ring rather than a border or drop shadow. The page reads as a measured engineering spec rather than a marketing brochure.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fog Canvas | `#fafafa` | `--color-fog-canvas` | Body background behind the hero, the logo row and every story section. This 2% off-white lets #ffffff surfaces lift without any drop shadow. |
| Paper Surface | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-surface` | Mockup frames, secondary pills, header buttons and the onboard-agent pill, with 11 background uses. It is the elevated tier, separated from the canvas by a ring rather than a shadow. |
| Jet Ink | `#171717` | `--color-jet-ink` | Headlines, emphasized story phrases, footer links, and the filled Deploy now and Sign Up buttons, with 52 text and 3 fill uses. It is near-black that takes the edge off pure #000000. |
| Graphite Text | `#4d4d4d` | `--color-graphite-text` | Nav links, body copy and customer-story sentence tails, with 92 uses, making it the most frequent text color. Gray carries the reading load so that #171717 can mean emphasis. |
| Pewter Icon | `#8f8f8f` | `--color-pewter-icon` | Icon-button glyphs, mockup placeholders and tertiary meta. It is the quiet third tier. Do not use it for running copy, because it falls near 3.2:1 contrast on #fafafa. |
| Mist Border | `#ebebeb` | `--color-mist-border` | The 1px ring on Talk to sales, Get a Demo and Log In, drawn as a box-shadow. It is the opaque hairline for controls that sit directly on the canvas. |
| Ash Ring | `#00000014` | `--color-ash-ring` | An 8% black ring around mockup cards and the onboard pill, with 9 uses. This translucent hairline darkens whatever surface lies beneath it. |
| Cobalt Signal | `#0070f3` | `--color-cobalt-signal` | One fill and one text use on the whole page, for link emphasis or a status mark. It is a rationed signal, not a brand wash. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |

## Tokens — Typography

### GeistSans — the single voice for display, UI and body, tuned by tracking rather than weight · `--font-geist-sans`

- **Substitute:** Geist itself (open source, Google Fonts) at the same 400/450/500. Inter at 420 for display and 400 for body; its taller x-height reads heavier than Geist at equal weight, so step down. Switzer at 400, which matches the 450 stroke closely.
- **Weights:** 400, 450, 500, 600
- **Sizes:** 11px, 13px, 14px, 16px, 24px, 40px, 56px, 64px
- **Line height:** 1.0 at 40–64px, 1.1 for 24px panel labels, 1.33 for 24px story copy, 1.38–1.5 for 13–16px UI text, 1.82 for 11px labels
- **Letter spacing:** -3.84px at 64px, -3.36px at 56px, -2.4px at 40px, -1.2px at 24px labels, -0.96px at 24px story copy, -0.32px at 16px, 0px at 13–14px, +0.2px at 11px
- **OpenType features:** `"calt" 0`, `"rlig"`, `"ss11"`
- **Role:** Weight 450 is the signature. It is a book weight between regular and medium that gives display type presence without the shout of 700. Tracking tightens in proportion to size, from -0.06em at 56–64px to -0.04em at 24px to -0.02em at 16px. That compression, not weight, is what makes headlines feel engineered. Disabling `calt` and enabling `ss11` swaps in alternate glyphs and keeps characters literal, a typographer's signal to an audience that reads code. The 40px step is a reconstruction for phones and does not appear on the desktop page.

### Geist Mono — technical labels, commands and uppercase eyebrows · `--font-geist-mono`

- **Substitute:** Geist Mono itself at 400/500. JetBrains Mono at 400, which matches stroke but runs slightly wider. IBM Plex Mono at 400.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px, 16px
- **Line height:** 1.25–1.67 (fixed 20px line box)
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at 12px, 14px and 16px
- **OpenType features:** `"calt" 0`, `"rlig"`, `"ss11"`
- **Role:** Mono appears in only 5 elements. It is punctuation rather than decoration, marking commands, the 12px uppercase eyebrow and code-adjacent strings. It is the same superfamily as the sans, so switching voices costs nothing in x-height or color. The pairing says "the product is a terminal" without turning the page into one.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | GeistSans | 500 | 11px | 1.82 | 0.2px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Geist Mono | 500 | 12px | 1.67 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | GeistSans | 400 | 13px | 1.38 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | GeistSans | 400 | 14px | 1.43 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | GeistSans | 450 | 16px | 1.5 | -0.32px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | GeistSans | 450 | 24px | 1.33 | -0.96px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | GeistSans | 450 | 24px | 1.1 | -1.2px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | GeistSans | 450 | 40px | 1.0 | -2.4px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | GeistSans | 450 | 56px | 1.0 | -3.36px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | GeistSans | 400 | 64px | 1.0 | -3.84px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set display and section headlines in GeistSans at 400–450 with -0.06em tracking (-3.36px at 56px) — compression carries authority, so weight stays quiet.
- Use #4d4d4d as the default text color and reserve #171717 for headlines, subject phrases and links — the 92-to-52 ratio is what makes ink read as emphasis.
- Draw every edge as a 1px box-shadow ring (#ebebeb or rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)) instead of a CSS border — the ring adds no layout height and keeps the 4px grid exact.
- Keep hero CTAs as 40px pills at 9999px and header controls as 32px rectangles at 6px — the radius split tells users which buttons are campaign and which are chrome.
- Let sections breathe with a 208px gap and the 1448px container — emptiness is the luxury signal here, not imagery.
- Enable `"ss11"` and disable `"calt"` on both Geist families — literal glyphs are the typographer's nod to a developer audience.
- Split story sentences between #171717 and #4d4d4d at 24px and weight 450 — the hierarchy lives inside the sentence instead of in a separate bold label.

### Don't

- Don't bold headlines to 700 out of habit — 450 at 56px is the system's thesis that size and tracking, not weight, carry hierarchy, and a heavy headline turns the spec sheet into a billboard.
- Don't fill the primary button with #0070f3 — blue has a budget of two uses on the page, and the CTA is #171717 by design.
- Don't add drop shadows such as 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) to cards — elevation is a 1px ring at 8% opacity, and a blurred shadow introduces depth the canvas never otherwise shows.
- Don't round cards to the conventional 12–16px — the 6px card radius is deliberately tight, and softer corners read consumer rather than infrastructure.
- Don't set body copy at the conventional 16px — the UI runs at 14px and 400 with a 1.43 line height, and 16px inflates every nav and footer row.
- Don't pick a modular scale that inserts 32px and 40px steps on desktop — the 24px-to-56px cliff is intentional, and in-between sizes blur the boundary between reading copy and chapter headlines.
- Don't use pure #000000 for text or buttons — it is reserved for the decorative prism, and #171717 is non-negotiable for UI ink because the 9% lift keeps large type from vibrating on #fafafa. Never let a second black creep in.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #fafafa (Fog Canvas)
- elevated surface: #ffffff (Paper Surface)
- primary text: #171717 (Jet Ink)
- secondary text: #4d4d4d (Graphite Text)
- tertiary text and icons: #8f8f8f (Pewter Icon)
- hairline ring: #ebebeb (Mist Border)
- primary action: #171717 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and graphs stay neutral: plot bars and lines in #171717 and #4d4d4d on #ffffff with #ebebeb gridlines, and allow #0070f3 only as a single highlighted series or point at full strength, so blue never outweighs the headline.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button labeled "Deploy now". Set the background to #171717, text to #ffffff, border to none and border-radius to 9999px. Use padding 0 12px, height 40px and font-family Geist (fallback ui-sans-serif, system-ui) at 16px, weight 500 and line-height 1.5, with no box-shadow. Place a secondary sibling 8px to its right labeled "Talk to sales" with the identical geometry, a #ffffff background, #171717 text and box-shadow 0 0 0 1px #ebebeb in place of a border. Do not use any blue.

2. Build a hero section on a #fafafa background inside a 1448px container with 24px side padding, using a three-column grid. In column one, add an h1 "Agentic Infrastructure" in Geist 64px, weight 400, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing -3.84px, color #171717, broken over two lines, followed 24px below by the dark and light pill buttons from prompt 1. In column two, center a solid black triangle about 128px wide with three concentric radial gradients fading from #ffffff to #fafafa behind it; treat this as decorative. In column three, stack three 14px weight-400 lines in #171717, 8px apart. Below, add a row of six monochrome #171717 logos spread edge to edge, 256px beneath the buttons.

3. Build a feature story block. On the left, add an h2 in Geist 56px, weight 450, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing -3.36px, color #171717, max-width 673px. Below it, 40px down, add a product mockup card with a #ffffff background, box-shadow 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08), border-radius 6px and padding 24px. Inside, use 14px weight-400 #171717 rows with 8px-radius tiles and 9999px chips, and fade the bottom 25% to #fafafa with a linear-gradient mask. On the right, add a 24px weight-450 sentence (line-height 1.33, letter-spacing -0.96px) whose first phrase is #171717 and remainder #4d4d4d, then 32px below a 13px #4d4d4d "Features" label and four 13px #171717 links spaced 4px apart. Leave 208px above the next section.

4. Build a sticky navigation bar, 64px tall, with a transparent background over #fafafa and no border or shadow. On the left, place a 16px black triangle logomark in an 8px-padded link, then Products and Resources (each with a 12px chevron), Enterprise and Pricing in Geist 14px, weight 400, color #4d4d4d, each 32px tall with 20px between items. On the right, separated by 8px, add Get a Demo and Log In (background #ffffff, text #171717, box-shadow 0 0 0 1px #ebebeb) and Sign Up (background #171717, text #ffffff). All three use border-radius 6px, padding 0 6px, height 32px and 14px weight 500.

### Layout

- **Page max-width:** 1448px (1024–1448px)
- **Section gap:** 208px (208–276px)
- **Card padding:** 24px (12–40px)
- **Element gap:** 12px (6–24px)

## Components

### Pill Button — Dark (Primary)

**Role:** Hero conversion action, Deploy now

A filled ink capsule. It has a #171717 background, #ffffff text, no border, a 9999px radius, 0 12px padding and a 40px height, and it is set in GeistSans 16px at weight 500 with no shadow. The fill is the page's darkest surface, so the button outranks every headline in contrast while staying achromatic. Use one per viewport. Black, not blue, signals the primary path.

### Pill Button — Light (Secondary)

**Role:** Alternate path, Talk to sales

The paired paper capsule. It has a #ffffff background, #171717 text, no CSS border, a 9999px radius, 0 12px padding, a 40px height, GeistSans 16px at weight 500, and a `0 0 0 1px #ebebeb` ring drawn as box-shadow. It always sits 8px to the right of the dark pill with matching geometry, so the pair reads as one decision with two weights. The ring replaces a border to avoid adding layout height.

### Onboard Agent Pill — Lifted

**Role:** Copy-to-agent utility action

The page's only lifted control. It has a #ffffff background, #171717 text, a 9999px radius, asymmetric 0 12px 0 8px padding to hug a leading icon, a 40px height and GeistSans 16px at weight 500. It carries the `sm` shadow: an 8% black ring, a 2px drop at 4% opacity and a #fafafa outer halo. This is the system outlier on elevation, allowed because it invites a paste action and needs one extra cue of tangibility.

### Header Buttons — Outline and Dark

**Role:** Account and sales entry points

Squared-off compact controls. Get a Demo and Log In use a #ffffff background, #171717 text and a `0 0 0 1px #ebebeb` ring. Sign Up uses a #171717 fill with #ffffff text. All three have a 6px radius, 0 6px padding, a 32px height and GeistSans 14px at weight 500. The 6px radius deliberately breaks the hero's pill rule, and that difference marks them as utility chrome rather than campaign calls to action.

### Navigation Bar — Sticky Transparent

**Role:** Persistent top-level wayfinding

A borderless 64px strip. It is sticky, has no fill of its own and no hairline, and shows #fafafa through. The logomark sits left in a 37×34 hit area with 8px padding. Products and Resources (with chevrons), Enterprise and Pricing are set in GeistSans 14px at weight 400 in #4d4d4d, each 32px tall. The three header buttons sit right with 8px gaps. Nav labels are gray and only the account buttons are ink, so attention drifts right toward conversion.

### Product Mockup Card

**Role:** Main content card, live product proof

A white frame fading into canvas. It has a #ffffff background, a `0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)` ring, a 6px radius, a 24px padding, and inner 8px tiles and 9999px chips. The bottom 25% dissolves into #fafafa through a gradient mask instead of closing with an edge. It contains a real interface (Notion's AI chat, Zapier's landing page) at 13–14px. The open bottom says "this continues": the card is a window into a running product rather than a framed artwork.

### Customer Proof Column

**Role:** Metric sentence with feature index

A split-tone sentence over a list. The headline sentence is GeistSans 24px at weight 450 with 1.33 line height and -0.96px tracking. The subject phrase is #171717 and the tail is #4d4d4d, so "Notion powers millions" carries the meaning in ink while "of agent conversations daily" recedes. Below it, a 13px #4d4d4d "Features" label tops four 13px #171717 links spaced 4px apart. Emphasis comes from a two-gray contrast within a single sentence, not from bold.

### Section Headline Block

**Role:** Story chapter opener

Massive and quiet. It is GeistSans 56px at weight 450 with a 1.0 line height and -3.36px tracking, in #171717 with no background, broken over two lines at a 673–927px measure. Headlines alternate between left alignment and a 316px indent from the container edge across chapters. Weight 450 at 56px is the signature: the size does the shouting so the weight does not have to.

### Hero Prism — Decorative

**Role:** Brand mark as centerpiece

A sculpted mark, not an icon. A solid #000000 equilateral triangle, roughly 128px wide (estimated; #000000 is decorative, not a system token), sits inside three concentric radial halos that fade from #ffffff to #fafafa, with a soft drop glow beneath. This is the only place pure black or depth appears. It is allowed as the deliberate outlier because the logomark is the single permitted image in an otherwise imageless hero.

### Logo Row

**Role:** Social proof strip

A monochrome sextet. Six customer wordmarks (Meta, DoorDash, OpenAI, SpaceX, The Weather Company, Polymarket) are set in #171717 at roughly 20px cap height (estimated). They are distributed edge to edge across the content width with no dividers, cards or captions, and sit about 256px below the hero CTAs. Brand colors are stripped to ink, so customer logos obey the same zero-hue budget as the site.

### Icon Button — Ghost

**Role:** Inline utility affordance

A tiny ghost square. It measures 24×24px, with no background, a #8f8f8f glyph, a 4px radius, 0px padding and GeistSans 14px at weight 400 in the line box. It renders as a bare icon until hovered. The 4px radius is the smallest in the system and marks the lowest-stakes interactive tier.

### Footer — Link Index

**Role:** Exhaustive product directory

A full-width index. It spans 1448px with 40px 24px padding, no background change and no top shadow. Multi-column link lists (Agent Stack, AI SDK, AI Gateway, Sandbox) are set in GeistSans 14px at weight 400 with 1.5 line height in #171717, under 13px #4d4d4d group labels. The footer behaves as a sitemap rather than a closing campaign, and it keeps the canvas unbroken.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set display and section headlines in GeistSans at 400–450 with -0.06em tracking (-3.36px at 56px) — compression carries authority, so weight stays quiet.
- Use #4d4d4d as the default text color and reserve #171717 for headlines, subject phrases and links — the 92-to-52 ratio is what makes ink read as emphasis.
- Draw every edge as a 1px box-shadow ring (#ebebeb or rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)) instead of a CSS border — the ring adds no layout height and keeps the 4px grid exact.
- Keep hero CTAs as 40px pills at 9999px and header controls as 32px rectangles at 6px — the radius split tells users which buttons are campaign and which are chrome.
- Let sections breathe with a 208px gap and the 1448px container — emptiness is the luxury signal here, not imagery.
- Enable `"ss11"` and disable `"calt"` on both Geist families — literal glyphs are the typographer's nod to a developer audience.
- Split story sentences between #171717 and #4d4d4d at 24px and weight 450 — the hierarchy lives inside the sentence instead of in a separate bold label.

### Don't

- Don't bold headlines to 700 out of habit — 450 at 56px is the system's thesis that size and tracking, not weight, carry hierarchy, and a heavy headline turns the spec sheet into a billboard.
- Don't fill the primary button with #0070f3 — blue has a budget of two uses on the page, and the CTA is #171717 by design.
- Don't add drop shadows such as 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) to cards — elevation is a 1px ring at 8% opacity, and a blurred shadow introduces depth the canvas never otherwise shows.
- Don't round cards to the conventional 12–16px — the 6px card radius is deliberately tight, and softer corners read consumer rather than infrastructure.
- Don't set body copy at the conventional 16px — the UI runs at 14px and 400 with a 1.43 line height, and 16px inflates every nav and footer row.
- Don't pick a modular scale that inserts 32px and 40px steps on desktop — the 24px-to-56px cliff is intentional, and in-between sizes blur the boundary between reading copy and chapter headlines.
- Don't use pure #000000 for text or buttons — it is reserved for the decorative prism, and #171717 is non-negotiable for UI ink because the 9% lift keeps large type from vibrating on #fafafa. Never let a second black creep in.

## Surfaces

| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Fog Canvas | `#fafafa` | Page body, hero, logo row and section backgrounds, with no banding between chapters |
| 1 | Paper Surface | `#ffffff` | Mockup cards, secondary pills and header buttons, always paired with a 1px ring |
| 2 | Jet Ink | `#171717` | Inverted fill for primary pills and Sign Up, the only dark surface on the page |

## Elevation

- **Secondary pills and header outline buttons:** `0 0 0 1px #ebebeb`
- **Product mockup cards and translucent frames:** `0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)`
- **Onboard-agent pill (the single lifted control):** `0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08), 0 2px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04), 0 0 0 1px #fafafa`
- **Drop-to-deploy well (sunken, one use):** `inset 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), inset 0 0 24px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14)`

The rule is that elevation is a single hairline ring delivered through box-shadow. Only one control earns a 2px drop, and only one well earns an inset. Where convention stacks three blur layers, this system uses one pixel.

## Imagery

The page uses no photography and no illustration in the conventional sense. Imagery consists of live product screenshots and reconstructed interfaces: Notion's AI chat panel, Zapier's landing page and a ghosted Strategy doc. They sit inside #ffffff frames with a 6px radius and an rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08) ring, with no drop shadow, and each fades into #fafafa at the bottom instead of closing with an edge. Raw image elements are 927px wide at 0px radius, so framing comes from the container rather than the bitmap. Icons are 14–16px single-stroke outlines in #171717 or #8f8f8f. The only glow on the page is the decorative radial halo around the black hero prism; it is not a system token and does not repeat. Customer logos are flattened to ink. The narrative is "real software, running now": proof through screenshots rather than mood through pictures.

## Layout

The container caps at 1448px with 24px gutters, and inner text blocks narrow to 1024–1080px. Sections are separated by 208–276px of open #fafafa with no background bands, rules or color shifts, so rhythm comes from whitespace alone. The hero is a three-column composition. On the left, the 64px "Agentic Infrastructure" headline sits over the two CTA pills, 8px apart. The center holds the haloed prism. On the right, three 14px tagline lines sit 8px apart. A six-logo row spans the full width beneath. Story chapters alternate between a headline block on the left with a mockup card and proof column, and an indented headline with the proof column on the left and the mockup on the right. The nav is sticky, transparent and 64px tall, with the logomark and four links on the left and three buttons on the right. The footer is a multi-column link index with 40px 24px padding. At 375px, use the 40px heading token for the hero, 80px section gaps and a single stacked column. Overall density: spacious.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #fafafa (Fog Canvas)
- elevated surface: #ffffff (Paper Surface)
- primary text: #171717 (Jet Ink)
- secondary text: #4d4d4d (Graphite Text)
- tertiary text and icons: #8f8f8f (Pewter Icon)
- hairline ring: #ebebeb (Mist Border)
- primary action: #171717 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and graphs stay neutral: plot bars and lines in #171717 and #4d4d4d on #ffffff with #ebebeb gridlines, and allow #0070f3 only as a single highlighted series or point at full strength, so blue never outweighs the headline.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button labeled "Deploy now". Set the background to #171717, text to #ffffff, border to none and border-radius to 9999px. Use padding 0 12px, height 40px and font-family Geist (fallback ui-sans-serif, system-ui) at 16px, weight 500 and line-height 1.5, with no box-shadow. Place a secondary sibling 8px to its right labeled "Talk to sales" with the identical geometry, a #ffffff background, #171717 text and box-shadow 0 0 0 1px #ebebeb in place of a border. Do not use any blue.

2. Build a hero section on a #fafafa background inside a 1448px container with 24px side padding, using a three-column grid. In column one, add an h1 "Agentic Infrastructure" in Geist 64px, weight 400, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing -3.84px, color #171717, broken over two lines, followed 24px below by the dark and light pill buttons from prompt 1. In column two, center a solid black triangle about 128px wide with three concentric radial gradients fading from #ffffff to #fafafa behind it; treat this as decorative. In column three, stack three 14px weight-400 lines in #171717, 8px apart. Below, add a row of six monochrome #171717 logos spread edge to edge, 256px beneath the buttons.

3. Build a feature story block. On the left, add an h2 in Geist 56px, weight 450, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing -3.36px, color #171717, max-width 673px. Below it, 40px down, add a product mockup card with a #ffffff background, box-shadow 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08), border-radius 6px and padding 24px. Inside, use 14px weight-400 #171717 rows with 8px-radius tiles and 9999px chips, and fade the bottom 25% to #fafafa with a linear-gradient mask. On the right, add a 24px weight-450 sentence (line-height 1.33, letter-spacing -0.96px) whose first phrase is #171717 and remainder #4d4d4d, then 32px below a 13px #4d4d4d "Features" label and four 13px #171717 links spaced 4px apart. Leave 208px above the next section.

4. Build a sticky navigation bar, 64px tall, with a transparent background over #fafafa and no border or shadow. On the left, place a 16px black triangle logomark in an 8px-padded link, then Products and Resources (each with a 12px chevron), Enterprise and Pricing in Geist 14px, weight 400, color #4d4d4d, each 32px tall with 20px between items. On the right, separated by 8px, add Get a Demo and Log In (background #ffffff, text #171717, box-shadow 0 0 0 1px #ebebeb) and Sign Up (background #171717, text #ffffff). All three use border-radius 6px, padding 0 6px, height 32px and 14px weight 500.

## Tracking Over Weight

The discipline is that hierarchy is earned through size and negative letter-spacing, never through boldness. Across 146 GeistSans elements, a single one uses weight 600. Headlines at 56–64px hold at 400–450 and are compressed to -0.06em, story copy at 24px is compressed to -0.04em, and UI text at 14px stays at 0. What breaks the system is any bold display line, any headline left at default tracking (which renders loose and generic at 56px), or a weight-700 subheading inserted to "help" scanning. To extend the system, derive tracking for any new size as a linear interpolation between -0.02em at 16px and -0.06em at 56px. Keep weight at 450 for anything above 20px, and use the #171717-versus-#4d4d4d split when a phrase needs emphasis.

## Rationed Chroma

The chromatic budget is one hue with two uses. #0070f3 appears on one background and one text element across a 10-section page, and the CTA, the logos, the icons and even the customer screenshots stay achromatic. Convention for a developer-platform homepage is a brand-blue primary button and gradient hero. The prism-and-ink approach rejects both, so the black triangle becomes the brand color. The system breaks the moment blue fills a button, tints a section band or appears in more than one element per viewport. To extend it, express status with shape and ink first (a filled versus outlined dot in #171717). Admit #0070f3 only where a user must locate a single interactive or live point, and keep it at full strength rather than as tints.

## Ring Geometry

Every edge is a box-shadow at 0 0 0 1px, not a border. Measured border-color is null across the page, while ring shadows appear on 13 elements. The ring sits outside the box, so a 40px pill stays 40px and the 4px grid never absorbs an extra 2px of border. The two ring colors are opaque #ebebeb for controls on canvas and translucent rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08) for frames that may overlap other surfaces. The system breaks when someone writes `border: 1px solid` (which shifts alignment by 2px), thickens the ring to 2px, or adds blur. To extend it, give new surfaces the 8% ring, reserve the `sm` lift for one tactile action per page, and use the inset `sm-2` only for drop targets.

## Similar Brands

- **Linear** — shares the near-black-on-off-white marketing canvas and compressed medium-weight display type; Linear leans darker and uses glow gradients that Vercel forbids.
- **Stripe** — shares the habit of live product UI as the primary imagery; Stripe spends a large chromatic budget on gradients where Vercel spends one hue on two elements.
- **Resend** — shares the developer-tool minimalism, mono accents and pill CTAs in ink rather than brand color; Resend sets its default theme dark.
- **Cursor** — shares the agent-era positioning and a monochrome canvas with screenshot-led storytelling; Cursor uses heavier headline weights.
- **Raycast** — shares the precision 1px hairline frames and product-window imagery; Raycast builds depth with shadows and color glows that this system replaces with rings.
